items.text: Braves trade Andrelton Simmons and Jose Briceno to the Angels for Erick Aybar, Sean Newcomb, Chris Ellis and cash
White Sox trade Richard Dotson and Scott Nielsen to the Yankees for Dan Pasqua, Mark Salas and Steve Rosenberg
Steve Carlton becomes a free agent (White Sox)
Andre Dawson becomes a free agent (Expos)
Rod Carew becomes a free agent (Angels)
Carlton Fisk becomes a free agent (White Sox)
Ray Schalk signs with the Giants
Giants trade Casey Stengel, Dave Bancroft and Bill Cunningham to the Braves for Billy Southworth and Joe Oeschger

note: 2026 regular-season games are not in Retrosheet yet, so 2026 here is postseason only, taken from Wikipedia's box scores. Retrosheet adds the full season after it ends.
